title: pilosella collina
intro: Pilosella collina, commonly known as Alpine Mouse-ear, is a flowering plant in the dandelion family (Asteraceae) native to mountainous regions of Europe. The plant is traditionally used to treat various health issues, including inflammation, digestive problems, and skin conditions, due to its health benefits which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Pilosella collina include reducing pain and inflammation, soothing digestive issues, and acting as an antiseptic, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, sesquiterpene lactones, and phenolic acids. These bioactive constituents contribute to the plant's ability to provide relief from various health conditions, making it a valuable natural remedy in traditional medicine.
